name: ZorbaHealth Peak UX WCAG 2.2 AA Gap Audit
scope: Standing goal: every core journey in the Peak UX Figma prototype, with every frame passing WCAG 2.2 AA and every flow walkable end-to-end in prototype mode.

proven_or_strong_evidence: Core Figma text contrast scan: 550 visible text nodes across five core Peak UX pages, 0 AA contrast failures.
Core Figma target-size scan: 112 interactive nodes, 0 WCAG 24x24 failures, 0 stricter 44x44 comfort failures after Mobile Patient tab patch.
Core Figma interactive metadata: 112 interactive nodes have zorba.a11y label/focusOrder/frame metadata, 0 missing entries.
Web PatientPicker role=option build-time a11y warning fixed locally and verified by npm run build.
partial_or_design_time_only: Focus order exists as Figma metadata but has not been runtime keyboard-tested.
Accessible names exist as Figma metadata but have not been verified with runtime screen-reader tooling.
Evidence card node 31:2 renders and contains WCAG/target/a11y notes, but local visual image inspection is blocked by sandbox loopback errors.
missing_or_unproved: All-frame WCAG coverage beyond the five core Peak UX pages is not yet proven.
Keyboard-only completion for web login, booking, consent, and audit search is not yet proven.
Visible focus at every runtime keyboard step is not yet proven.
Reduced-motion behavior in running web and mobile apps is not yet proven.
Runtime mobile screen-reader labels and touch semantics are not yet proven.
Current State decision-count baseline is still missing, so fewer-decisions-than-current-state remains unproved.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Figma MCP approximate contrast scan checked 550 visible text nodes across Web Patient, Web Hospital, Web Meeting, Mobile Patient, and Mobile Hospital Peak UX pages; 0 AA issues.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Run rendered web/mobile contrast checks in light and dark themes and extend Figma scan to every non-core frame before claiming every-frame WCAG pass.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Token contrast pairs and text contrast are documented, but controls, focus indicators, chart/status affordances, and icon strokes have not been systematically checked as non-text contrast.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Check control boundaries, icons, focus rings, status indicators, and selection states across all frames and rendered apps.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Prototype reactions are wired, but runtime keyboard-only completion has not been exercised for login, booking, consent, meeting, records, or staff audit/triage flows.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Run browser keyboard walkthroughs and record focus path evidence for every web core journey.

wcag_criteria.evidence: 112 core Figma interactive nodes have zorba.a11y focusOrder metadata with 0 missing entries.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Verify runtime DOM tab order and mobile screen-reader traversal order.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Figma notes and token guidance mention focus, but no runtime focus-visible screenshots/walkthroughs are attached.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Capture focus-visible states for every keyboard step in the web core journeys.

wcag_criteria.evidence: 112 core Figma interactive nodes have accessible-name metadata derived from layer names or visible child text.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Verify runtime accessible names match visible labels for web and mobile controls.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Figma target-size scan checked 112 core interactive nodes; 0 WCAG 24x24 failures and 0 44x44 comfort failures after patching 45 Mobile Patient tab instances to 62x45.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Extend target-size scan to every frame outside the five core pages and verify rendered mobile touch targets.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Peak UX DNA documents reduced-motion behavior, but running web/mobile reduced-motion behavior has not been verified.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Exercise prefers-reduced-motion on web and system Reduce Motion on mobile; confirm non-essential animation is disabled.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Figma metadata and visible labels exist for core prototype controls; PatientPicker exposes selected option state locally.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Verify rendered form labels, instructions, errors, and required states for auth, booking, consent, and audit search.

wcag_criteria.evidence: Figma core interactive metadata has 0 missing label/focus entries; web PatientPicker role=option now has aria-selected and npm run build no longer reports that jsx-a11y warning.
wcag_criteria.remaining: Run runtime accessibility inspection for role/name/state across web and mobile core journeys.

prototype_scope_coverage.connector_limitation: Current Figma connector metadata root lists only Page 1, while known node 31:2 is reachable directly. Write-capable use_figma was not available this pass, so no new Figma annotations were added.

next_required_evidence: Authoritative Current State Figma URL/key or docs/design/current-state-dna.json decision counts.
All-frame Figma contrast, target-size, and metadata coverage, including Auth & Journey Map and any state frames not in the five core pages.
Runtime web keyboard/focus-visible walkthroughs for login, booking, consent grant/revoke, meeting join/end, records ask, hospital triage, summary, and audit search.
Runtime mobile screen-reader/touch target checks in Expo/iOS/Android viewports.
Reduced-motion checks in running web and mobile apps.
